description: Shows which areas of Australian retirement rules the figures cover: the categories, such as Age Pension, super caps and aged care, with each one's id for search_figures and its number of figures. Also returns the data release, the newest and the oldest date on which a figure was last checked against its source, the scope statement, and links to the documentation and the JSON files.
name: list_categories

data_release.description: The number of the data release these values come from.

last_verified.description: The newest date on which a figure was last checked against its source.

scope.description: What this site does and does not provide.

title: List categories
